name: Raise taxes
notes: DRAFT. Tax rate up one step; -4 loyalty every season at the high rate.

name: Lower taxes
notes: DRAFT. Tax rate down one step.

name: Hang the brigands in the forum
notes: DRAFT. Rome likes order; the town is frightened. Pleases the prefect.

name: Hear petitions in the forum
notes: DRAFT. A day of judgement and favours. Pleases the treasurer, who hears what people owe.

name: Recruit 50 soldiers
notes: DRAFT. Arms and tunics for the recruits.

name: Refill the cohorts
notes: DRAFT (v9). Townsmen take the places of the fallen, up to the army's best strength (at most 100 at once): 5 denarii each (6 with javelins), a shield each (timber 1 per 10 men) and iron for swords and javelins (1 per 10 men per weapon). Fewer townsmen.

name: Dismiss 50 soldiers
notes: DRAFT. Saves pay; Rome likes a strong garrison.

name: Build or plant
notes: DRAFT. One building on a free plot; its cost and time come from buildings.csv.

name: Lay the keel of a ship
notes: DRAFT. Ready in two seasons. Needs a free berth.

name: Send a trade convoy
notes: DRAFT. One ship to one town; sell and buy there. Back next season (Aquileia: in two).

name: Hold a festival
notes: DRAFT. Games and a feast. Half the effect if held two seasons running.

name: Sacrifice at the temple
notes: DRAFT. The governor sacrifices in public. Pleases the haruspex.

name: Decree honouring Tiberius
notes: DRAFT. An inscription in the forum to the Emperor.

name: Send gifts to Rome
notes: DRAFT. On top of the regular tribute.

name: Listen to the sages
notes: DRAFT. The old men read the sky: you learn next season's wind before it comes.

name: Buy from passing merchants
notes: DRAFT. Greek and Italian ships call at the quay in the sailing season. Buy up to 20 loads at once, no ship of ours needed, at half again the base price (grain 750 a month). No luxuries.

name: Clear new fields
notes: DRAFT. Cut the scrub and build terraces on the hillside: one more field plot, ready in two seasons. At most 16 field plots.

name: Treat with a tribe
notes: DRAFT. Diplomacy and gold: gifts to the chiefs and a d20 with your best talker. Success: they cede land (new field plots) and keep the peace.

name: March against a tribe
notes: DRAFT. Sword and fire: needs 150 soldiers; a d20 battle. Victory: their land and loot, but the tribe stays hostile and raids. Defeat: men lost.

name: Train 25 slingers
notes: DRAFT. Shepherds of the hills with slings: they thin the enemy before the clash (12% of a lane each group). Pay 4 a season each.

name: Raise 30 archers from the townsmen
notes: DRAFT. A citizen militia with hunting bows: in front of a lane (8% each group) or, at home, on the walls (4% off every lane). Pay 2 a season each.

name: Raise 10 horsemen
notes: DRAFT. A small mounted troop: guards the commander (if you lose while leading, 60% they carry you off alive) or strikes a flank (+2 on one lane), or pursues (half again the plunder). Pay 10 a season each.

name: Build a scorpion
notes: DRAFT. A bolt-throwing engine: 10% off the lane in front of it, and +1 to every lane on a march against a tribe. Upkeep 10 a season. Four at most.

name: Issue javelins (pila) to the infantry
notes: DRAFT. Once for the whole infantry: each cohort's volley thins the crowd in front of it by 5%.

name: Issue short swords (gladii) to the infantry
notes: DRAFT. Once for the whole infantry: a shield line counts 2.1 men of theirs instead of 1.75.

name: Build a ballista
notes: DRAFT. A torsion engine that hurls stones: 15% off the lane in front of it before the clash, +2 to every lane on a march (it breaks their stockade). Upkeep 15 a season. Two at most.
